field.label: Enable
field.help: Watch the selected interfaces and re-request their IPv4 DHCP lease while they hold an unwanted address.

field.label: Interfaces
field.help: Only enabled interfaces whose IPv4 configuration type is DHCP can be watched, and never the LAN. DHCPv6 and prefix delegation on the same interface are left alone.

field.label: Unwanted networks
field.help: An address inside one of these IPv4 networks is unwanted, for example the private LAN of an ISP gateway in passthrough mode such as 172.31.254.0/24. Enter networks with a prefix of /8 or longer, at most 32 of them.

field.label: Private ranges are unwanted
field.help: Also treat every private (RFC 1918), shared (100.64.0.0/10) and link-local address as unwanted. Enable only if the ISP normally hands this router a public address. With CGNAT (100.64.0.0/10) this would retry forever.
